trace.name: Lacquered conductor
trace.description: An insulated iron trace for a surface or buried circuit run.

via.name: Insulated via
via.description: A sleeved vertical joint between a floor trace and its buried layer.

rack.name: Galvanic rack
rack.description: Holds a finite galvanic cell and sends a timed electrical pulse.

cell.name: Galvanic cell
cell.description: A finite iron-carbon and brine pulse cell for the rack.

switch.name: Knife switch
switch.description: A hand-operated contact that passes pulses only when closed.

lamp.name: Shielded arc lamp
lamp.description: A pulse-lit lamp that widens nearby sight while charged.

gate.name: Latch gate
gate.description: Blocks movement until a pulse releases its latch briefly.

drain.name: Sump pump
drain.description: A pulsed pump that drains nearby standing water and temporary floods.

sensor.name: Field sensor
sensor.description: Passes pulses only while its chosen condition detects mass, water, or a nearby threat.

relay.name: One-way relay
relay.description: Receives a pulse from behind and sends it only toward its facing.

counter.name: Counted relay
counter.description: Passes one pulse after a chosen number of received pulses.

piston.name: Crank piston
piston.description: A directional actuator that pushes up to three movable crates; a sticky setting pulls one back.

crate.name: Movable freight crate
crate.description: A physical blocking crate that a powered piston can shift and a buried sensor can weigh.
